# Radu G. Muresan — Chicago Real Estate Broker

> Radu G. Muresan is an independent Chicago real estate broker and Illinois Licensed Real Estate Managing Broker (License #471.012113, IDFPR). He helps buyers, sellers, first-time buyers and investors in Uptown, Edgewater and Chicago's North Side, with full service in English and Romanian. Phone (773) 860-7617 · radu.realtor@yahoo.com.

## Key facts
- Licence: Illinois Licensed Real Estate Managing Broker, #471.012113 (Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation)
- Membership: National Association of Realtors (NAR)
- Languages: English, Romanian
- Focus areas: Uptown (ZIP 60640, 60613) and Edgewater (ZIP 60660, 60640) on Chicago's lakefront
- Also serving: West Ridge, Albany Park, Rogers Park, Lincoln Square, Riverdale and greater Chicagoland
- Property types: condos, townhomes, multi-family buildings, foreclosures and short sales
- Commissions: negotiable and agreed in writing before listing
- Availability: 7 days a week

## Services
- [Buyers](https://radurealtor.com/#services): representation from neighborhood research to closing
- [Sellers](https://radurealtor.com/#services): pricing analysis, marketing plan and staging advice
- [First-time buyers](https://radurealtor.com/#services): guidance on financing, inspections and closing
- [Investment properties](https://radurealtor.com/#services): multi-family buildings, condos and townhomes
